sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

(16.11.2023) The respondent nos. 1 to 4 came forward as the claimants asking for compensation in relation to death of Ravinder Sharma who was husband of the respondent no. 1, father of the respondent nos. 2 & 3 and son of the respondent no. 4.

The Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Jammu came to award compensation of an amount of Rs.
42,90,500/- alongwith interest in favour of the claimants to be apportioned in the manner as set out in the award.

The award of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Jammu is dated 22.12.2021 which has come to be challenged through the present appeal under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 by the insurer i.e. Reliance Insurance Company Limited of the offending vehicle.

During the pendency of the appeal, the respondent no. 4-mother of the deceased/victim has also expired leaving only respondents no. 1 to 3 as ultimate beneficiaries of the compensation payable in their favour in terms of the award.

This Court in terms of an order dated 14.02.2022 came to direct deposit of the entire awarded Reliance General Insurance Co. Ltd vs Neetu Sharma And Others on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114146437/
1 amount alongwith interest which stands deposited as is born out from office noting dated 28.02.2022.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Deposited amount is to the extent of Rs. 53,45,296/-.

Learned counsel for the claimants/respondents no. 1 to 3 submits that it is only Rs. 50,000/-
amount which was received during the trial of the claim petition and till date not even a single penny of compensation has been received by the claimants/respondents no. 1 to 3 and for this purpose the claimants/respondents no. 1 to 3 have come forward with an application CM no. 1734/2022.
The respondent no. 1 is widow and the respondents no. 2 & 3 are minor children of the deceased.
A case is made out for direction for release of part amount of the deposited award amount.

Accordingly, an amount of Rs. 15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lacs) is directed to be released in favour of the respondent no. 1 i.e. Neetu Sharma, wife of the deceased-Ravinder Sharma for enabling her to make use of the released amount for meeting day to day necessities of life for her own person as well as for need and necessities of two minor children.

The release of the amount of Rs. 15,00,000/- in favour of the respondent no. 1 is subject to an undertaking to be furnished by her that in the event of revision of the amount of compensation paid,
the respondent no. 1 shall abide by the direction as may be given by this Court in the context of quantum of compensation ultimately held to be payable in favour of the claimants/respondents no.
1 to 3.
Application stands disposed of.
List the main matter on 06.02.2024.
(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE JAMMU 16.11.2023 Shivalee Reliance General Insurance Co. Ltd vs Neetu Sharma And Others on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114146437/
